# Corpunex

> Online company registration, GST, accounting, trademark filing, and yearly corporate compliance for founders and growing businesses in India.

Filings are prepared and certified by qualified Chartered Accountants (CAs), Company Secretaries (CSs), and advocates.

## Core Services

- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/private-limited-company): Standard structure for startups raising equity or granting ESOPs. Includes DIN, DSC, SPICe+ filing, PAN, TAN, and bank account setup.
- [Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/llp-registration): Limited liability for professional services and partnerships with lower annual compliance burden.
- [One Person Company (OPC) Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/one-person-company): Separate legal entity with 100% solo founder ownership and limited liability.
- [Indian Subsidiary Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/indian-subsidiary): Incorporation for foreign companies and NRI/overseas founders expanding into India.
- [Sole Proprietorship Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/sole-proprietorship): Single-owner setup via Udyam, GST, and current bank account.
- [Partnership Firm Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/partnership-firm-registration): Deed drafting and ROF registration.
- [Section 8 Company](https://www.corpunex.com/services/business-registration/section-8-company): Non-profit company under Companies Act, 2013 with 12A/80G assistance.
- [GST Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/gst-taxation/gst-registration): Application, ARN tracking, and certificate issuance for goods and services.
- [GST Return Filing](https://www.corpunex.com/services/gst-taxation/gst-return-filing): Monthly and quarterly GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and annual GSTR-9 reconciliations.
- [Income Tax Return Filing](https://www.corpunex.com/services/gst-taxation/income-tax-filing): Corporate ITR-6, LLP ITR-5, and individual ITR filings by CAs.
- [Annual ROC Compliance](https://www.corpunex.com/services/corporate-compliance/annual-roc-compliance): AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, DIR-3 KYC, and AGM documentation.
- [Change of Directors](https://www.corpunex.com/services/corporate-compliance/change-of-directors): Appointment or resignation via DIR-11 and DIR-12.
- [Company Strike Off / Fast Track Exit](https://www.corpunex.com/services/corporate-compliance/close-a-company): Form STK-2 filing to close inactive companies cleanly.
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/trademark-ip/trademark-registration): Search, class classification, and TM-A filing.
- [Trademark Objection Reply](https://www.corpunex.com/services/trademark-ip/trademark-objection-reply): Formal legal responses under Section 9 and Section 11 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
- [Startup India Recognition](https://www.corpunex.com/services/startup-services/startup-india-recognition): DPIIT certificate application for Section 80-IAC tax exemption and angel tax relief.
- [Startup Odisha Recognition](https://www.corpunex.com/services/startup-services/startup-odisha): Recognition, monthly allowance, and state seed fund guidance.
- [Udyam MSME Registration](https://www.corpunex.com/services/startup-services/udyam-msme-registration): MSME certificate for priority lending and interest subsidies.
- [FSSAI Food Licence](https://www.corpunex.com/services/licences-registrations/fssai-licence): Basic registration, state license, and central license for food businesses.
- [Import Export Code (IEC)](https://www.corpunex.com/services/licences-registrations/import-export-code): DGFT 10-digit business identification number for cross-border trade.

## Interactive Tools & Resources

- [GST Calculator](https://www.corpunex.com/tools/gst-calculator): Calculate inclusive and exclusive GST for standard Indian rates (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) with CGST, SGST, and IGST breakdown.
- [Company Type Finder](https://www.corpunex.com/tools/company-type-finder): Interactive decision tool comparing Private Limited, LLP, OPC, and Proprietorship based on capital, founders, and fundraising intent.
- [Compliance Calendar](https://www.corpunex.com/compliance-calendar): Chronological deadlines for ROC, GST, Advance Tax, TDS, and trademark renewals.
- [Legal & Business Glossary](https://www.corpunex.com/glossary): Explanations of DIN, DSC, MOA, AOA, SPICe+, RUN, GSTR, and other statutory terms.
